title: Billion Dollar Bully: Yelp documentary producers Kaylie Milliken & Mellissa Wood
summary: Louis Rossmann interviews Kaylie Milliken and Mellissa Wood, producers of the documentary Billion Dollar Bully, about Yelp's alleged practices toward businesses.
why: Recommended as a good conversation and starting point on Yelp's alleged bullying of businesses.

quote.text: he talks with two of the people behind the movie Billion Dollar Bully.
